notes.title: Improvement update of the demo
notes.content:
Hi, folks, here is another much needed update from your faithful Steppers on your favorite metroidvania Sweet Dreams Dahlia. We've heard your needs, recommendations, feedback and we've addressed what we could manage in our latest update.

Here is a list of all the changes we've done:


 New animations for the main character, Dahlia
 Optimized graphics
 Tonk-Clank’s spider enemy shooting has been regulated
 Rebalanced enemies in some of the more difficult locations
 Tweaked the spawn timing of Infected Phantasian Nests
 Fixed camera positioning and zoom in certain areas
 Added slow-motion camera effect when Dahlia dies for better clarity
 Fixed Dahlia’s spontaneous rotation when colliding with geometry
 Various bug fixes


Demo is available now, download and enjoy. ːsteamhappyː

Can't wait for your feedback.

notes.title: Much needed performance improvements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678798/a6acc89dc623cfb2b1402988d3c17f7d8849de45.gif

Hi everyone, thank you all for the constructive and positive feedback.

We've been hard at work at the past few days to improve performance of Sweet Dreams Dahlia. And even though it still won't run on your smart fridge, it should twice, thrice or even quadruple your fps! Yay :)

Here is a list of improvements that are live on the last update of the demo:



 Optimized performance, higher FPS
 Added support for 120, 144, 165, and 240 FPS in the Options Menu
 Synced animations with the smear effect of the Dreamweaver.
 Fixed an issue where the map was unresponsive when opened.
 Corrected some dialogue in the narrative.
 Fixed the camera offset issue at the beginning.
 Decreased the spawn time of the Infected.
 Removed a restricted camera in the level to make enemy appearances more predictable.
 Fixed camera glitch when loading the intro level
 Fixed enemy AI bugs when spawning flying enemies


TEST IT NOW!
